steps.objective: Build the real sidebar route components for GAMBIT v0.1 — replace the destination-button stubs with a small client-side router, render distinct route panes for Roster, Project, MCP Store, Harness, Methodology, Settings. DoctorRoute ships as a stub placeholder only — a parallel Agent B branch (feat/v0.1-doctor) owns the real Doctor dashboard and will overwrite the stub on merge. No URL syncing (Tauri 2 desktop, no browser history needs). Active route persists to localStorage so the user comes back to the same view after restart. Wire palette Navigate-group commands to switch routes.
